name: Improved Shot on the Run (Combat)
body:
You deftly loose shots while keeping the momentum going.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Dodge, Mobility, Point-Blank Shot, Shot on the Run, base attack bonus +9.

Benefit(s): When you use Shot on the Run, you can select two targets to attack during your movement instead of one. The second attack made this way is made at your full base attack bonus – 5. All restrictions of Shot on the Run apply to both targets, and your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from either target. You can’t target the same creature twice. You must be able to make multiple attacks in a round with the weapon used.
